what_works: Custom display font built from the texture of meat cuts (red field + thin white fat-lines) — the wordmark is the brand. A mechanic shop or painter with a meaningful surname can use the same trick: a single big custom-looking serif/grotesk wordmark on a flat saturated field IS the hero.
what_does_not_translate: Custom font design is real branding work; the contractor build substitutes a heavy free Google font (e.g. Bebas Neue, Anton, Antonio) at maximum scale instead of paying for a custom face.
type_observations: Single oversized custom display face; body type fades to a tiny humanist sans so nothing competes.
